LESSON: WRITING 8.3.1 FUNCTIONAL WRITING: FORMAL LETTER

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.3: Writing 8.3.1 Functional Writing: Formal Letter
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 8.3.1 Functional Writing: Formal Letter, part of Strand 8 in Grade 6 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: which formal information was passed on during the pre-colonial days. Why do we write letters?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 8.3.1 Functional Writing: Formal Letter together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: This is enhanced as the learner interacts with technology when studying a collection of sample letters

and reads, online or offline.

● Creativity and Imagination: This is developed as the learner interacts with ideas that inspire creative thinking when

preparing charts and discussing components of formal letters.

● Integrity: This is enhanced as the learner displays transparency when reading their own letters aloud for review and

makes corrections.
